name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Magnitude: Vision-First Browser Automation Agent
short_description: Magnitude is an open-source, vision-first browser agent designed for automation tasks. Built on TypeScript and leveraging frameworks like Playwright and Selenium, it simplifies browser interactions for testing and RPA applications.
author: sagekit

sections.overview:
Magnitude is an open-source browser agent designed to automate web interactions through vision-based understanding. Built on TypeScript and leveraging frameworks like Playwright and Selenium, it enables developers to create browser automation workflows for testing and robotic process automation (RPA) applications. The vision-first approach allows the agent to understand page content visually, simplifying complex browser interactions. Magnitude is particularly valuable for teams building automated testing suites, web scraping pipelines, and RPA solutions that require reliable browser control. The project is actively maintained with comprehensive documentation and a growing community of contributors.
Automate end-to-end web testing workflows to ensure application reliability.
Develop browser-based RPA solutions to integrate applications without APIs.
Conduct automated UI testing to validate user interface elements and functionality.
Integrate Magnitude with CI/CD pipelines to automate testing during deployment.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install sagekit/magnitude`
`git clone https://github.com/sagekit/magnitude`
sections.usage:
```
Automate the process of [TASK] using Magnitude. The task should involve browser interactions such as form filling, data scraping, or testing. Specify the target website URL and any specific elements to interact with. Example: 'Automate the process of filling out a contact form on [WEBSITE URL]. The form includes fields for name, email, and message. Use Magnitude to fill in the details and submit the form.'
```
Copy

```
Magnitude successfully automated the process of filling out a contact form on the specified website. The script navigated to the URL, identified the form fields, and filled in the details as follows: Name: John Doe, Email: john.doe@example.com, Message: 'I am interested in your services and would like more information.' The form was submitted successfully, and a confirmation message was displayed. The entire process took approximately 10 seconds to complete, demonstrating the efficiency of Magnitude in automating browser interactions.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
